scope: Posthoc development diagnosis of the original recovery TEST positions. Historical scores remain unchanged. Contacts are observations, not causal proof. Fixed64 held endpoints only; no new training, native rollout, noise, driven transit or physical validation.

geometry.scope: Configured simulator dimensions; provisional ball and bucket depth, no physical calibration.

focused_correction.rule: For all five losses, restore only board height to the matched parent-BC value; retain the other four recovery-BC coordinates and bucket.
focused_correction.coupled_geometry: With nominal gap unchanged, restoring board_height also shifts derived absolute release Z by the same height delta. This is one shot-parameter change, not an isolated physical board displacement; no gap compensation.
focused_correction.rationale: Three losses became setup rejects, including a low board/table branch collision and a missing board IK branch. Height restoration tests admission sensitivity; it need not fix either released miss. Their larger gaps remain a separate hypothesis, not a second intervention.

limitations: Posthoc development diagnosis of the original recovery TEST positions. Historical scores remain unchanged. Contacts are observations, not causal proof. Fixed64 held endpoints only; no new training, native rollout, noise, driven transit or physical validation.
A changed parameter and changed outcome are associated; one-coordinate intervention remains a hypothesis.
Finite IK counts and rejected branch pairs do not prove no feasible solution exists.
Table/bucket force channels are permitted and do not alone identify rim contact or causal assistance.
Every inspected TEST position is now development data; no future result here establishes generalization.
